scope: All matching direct Link Skill Buff Effect node stats and related condition nodes in the pinned 3.29.1 Default passive tree. It does not establish their arithmetic, stacking, or runtime activation state.

retention.sourceLicense: The official skilltree-export repository had no declared repository license at the pinned commit.
retention.dataLicense: No affirmative redistribution license for raw game data was established by the inspected source.
retention.provenance: Manually reviewed minimal node/condition records from the pinned official Default-tree export listed in AUD-003.
retention.redistribution: Only minimal factual identifiers, values, and condition flags are retained; raw export redistribution is not asserted.
retention.derivation: Records are a manual bounded scan result, not a generated copy of the source payload.
retention.attribution: Grinding Gear Games and the exact repository commit, file, and hash are recorded in the source registry and AUD-003.
retention.retainedMaterial: Node IDs, short names, values, condition identifiers, and limited applicability metadata.
retention.notVendored: Raw data.json, sprites, full node text, and all unrelated tree records are not vendored.
retention.uncertainty: Stacking, arithmetic, target scope beyond literal wording, and runtime condition activation are not established.

records.limitations: The record identifies a direct source but not stack arithmetic with other effects.
records.replacementRule: Replace through a new pinned Default-tree scan recorded in a superseding AUD-003.
